title: 學華語向前走 2A — Lesson 4
description: Vocabulary from lesson 4 of the textbook 學華語向前走 (Let's Learn Mandarin) 2A, with original example sentences written for young beginners (Traditional characters).

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ zhōumò zuò shénme?
exampleSentences.english: What do you do on the weekend?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天是週末，我們不上學。
exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān shì zhōumò, wǒmen bú shàngxué.
exampleSentences.english: Today is the weekend, so we don't go to school.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末媽媽帶我去公園散步，我們看到很多鴨子。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò māma dài wǒ qù gōngyuán sànbù, wǒmen kàndào hěn duō yāzi.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend Mum takes me for a walk in the park, and we see lots of ducks.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週末我跟朋友一起踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ gēn péngyou yìqǐ tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: On the weekend I play soccer with my friends.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan chī hànbǎo.
exampleSentences.english: I like eating hamburgers.

exampleSentences.pinyin: hànbǎo yào yòng liǎng zhī shǒu ná.
exampleSentences.english: You hold a hamburger with two hands.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 生日派對上有很多漢堡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shēngrì pàiduì shàng yǒu hěn duō hànbǎo.
exampleSentences.english: There are lots of hamburgers at the birthday party.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸下班時買了漢堡回家。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba xiàbān shí mǎi le hànbǎo huí jiā.
exampleSentences.english: Dad bought some hamburgers on his way home from work.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè shì shǔtiáo.
exampleSentences.english: These are french fries.

exampleSentences.pinyin: shǔtiáo yào chèn rè chī.
exampleSentences.english: French fries should be eaten while they are hot.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我和妹妹分一份薯條吃。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hé mèimei fēn yí fèn shǔtiáo chī.
exampleSentences.english: My sister and I share one serving of french fries.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 薯條上面可以加番茄醬。
exampleSentences.pinyin: shǔtiáo shàngmiàn kěyǐ jiā fānqiéjiàng.
exampleSentences.english: You can put tomato sauce on the french fries.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chūqù.
exampleSentences.english: I want to go out.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba chūqù le.
exampleSentences.english: Dad has gone out.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 外面下雨，我們不要出去。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wàimiàn xiàyǔ, wǒmen bú yào chūqù.
exampleSentences.english: It is raining outside, so we are not going out.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天天氣很好，我們出去騎腳踏車。
exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqù qí jiǎotàchē.
exampleSentences.english: The weather is nice today, so we go out for a bike ride.

exampleSentences.pinyin: qǐng xiān xiě míngzi.
exampleSentences.english: Please write your name first.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiān lái.
exampleSentences.english: I will go first.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen xiān xǐshǒu, zài chīfàn.
exampleSentences.english: We wash our hands first, then we eat.

exampleSentences.pinyin: chūmén qián, xiān chuān hǎo xiézi.
exampleSentences.english: Before going out, put your shoes on first.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yào chī dànchǎofàn.
exampleSentences.english: I want to eat egg fried rice.

exampleSentences.pinyin: dànchǎofàn lǐ yǒu jīdàn hé cōng.
exampleSentences.english: Egg fried rice has eggs and spring onion in it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 媽媽做蛋炒飯，我幫她打蛋。
exampleSentences.pinyin: māma zuò dànchǎofàn, wǒ bāng tā dǎ dàn.
exampleSentences.english: Mum makes egg fried rice, and I help her crack the eggs.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 今天學校午餐吃蛋炒飯，我吃得很飽。
exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān xuéxiào wǔcān chī dànchǎofàn, wǒ chī de hěn bǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Today's school lunch was egg fried rice, and I ate until I was full.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen wǎnshang liù diǎn chī wǎncān.
exampleSentences.english: We have dinner at six o'clock in the evening.

exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba, wǎncān hǎo le ma?
exampleSentences.english: Dad, is dinner ready?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 全家人在餐廳一起吃晚餐，我很開心。
exampleSentences.pinyin: quánjiārén zài cāntīng yìqǐ chī wǎncān, wǒ hěn kāixīn.
exampleSentences.english: The whole family has dinner together at a restaurant, and I am happy.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺奶奶來我們家，晚餐很熱鬧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye nǎinai lái wǒmen jiā, wǎncān hěn rènao.
exampleSentences.english: Grandpa and Grandma came to our house, and dinner was lively.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ chī wǎnfàn le ma?
exampleSentences.english: Have you had dinner yet?

exampleSentences.pinyin: jīntiān wǎnfàn chī shénme?
exampleSentences.english: What are we having for dinner tonight?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我玩了很久，媽媽叫我回家吃晚飯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ wán le hěn jiǔ, māma jiào wǒ huí jiā chī wǎnfàn.
exampleSentences.english: I played for a long time, and Mum called me home to eat dinner.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 晚飯後，我和弟弟一起洗碗。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǎnfàn hòu, wǒ hé dìdi yìqǐ xǐ wǎn.
exampleSentences.english: After dinner, my brother and I wash the bowls together.

exampleSentences.pinyin: xiàkè hòu, wǒmen zài qù zhǎo nǐ.
exampleSentences.english: After class, we will come and find you.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen chī wán fàn zài wán, hǎo ma?
exampleSentences.english: Let's play after we finish eating, OK?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 等爸爸回家，我們再去超市。
exampleSentences.pinyin: děng bàba huí jiā, wǒmen zài qù chāoshì.
exampleSentences.english: Once Dad gets home, we will go to the supermarket.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 午餐後，我們去操場，再踢足球。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǔcān hòu, wǒmen qù cāochǎng, zài tī zúqiú.
exampleSentences.english: After lunch we go to the school field and then play soccer.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ yào chī miàn ma?
exampleSentences.english: Do you want to eat noodles?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 這碗麵裡放了很多青菜。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè wǎn miàn lǐ fàng le hěn duō qīngcài.
exampleSentences.english: This bowl of noodles has lots of greens in it.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我生病的時候，媽媽會煮麵給我吃。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ shēngbìng de shíhou, māma huì zhǔ miàn gěi wǒ chī.
exampleSentences.english: When I am sick, Mum cooks noodles for me to eat.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 週六中午，爸爸帶我去吃麵。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zhōuliù zhōngwǔ, bàba dài wǒ qù chī miàn.
exampleSentences.english: On Saturday at lunchtime, Dad takes me out for noodles.

words.definition: completed action marker; also situational change (a new state)

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ chī le yí ge hànbǎo.
exampleSentences.english: I ate a hamburger.

exampleSentences.pinyin: lǎoshī xiě le sān ge zì.
exampleSentences.english: The teacher wrote three characters.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ xiě wán le zì, jiù qù wán.
exampleSentences.english: I finished my writing, then I went to play.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 昨天下午，爸爸修好了我的腳踏車。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zuótiān xiàwǔ, bàba xiū hǎo le wǒ de jiǎotàchē.
exampleSentences.english: Yesterday afternoon Dad fixed my bike.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yào yì wǎn tāng.
exampleSentences.english: I would like a bowl of soup.

exampleSentences.pinyin: tāng hěn tàng, yào mànmàn hē.
exampleSentences.english: The soup is very hot, so drink it slowly.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 冬天在家，我最喜歡喝番茄湯。
exampleSentences.pinyin: dōngtiān zài jiā, wǒ zuì xǐhuan hē fānqié tāng.
exampleSentences.english: In winter at home, I love drinking tomato soup the most.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爺爺煮的湯，大家都說好喝。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yéye zhǔ de tāng, dàjiā dōu shuō hǎohē.
exampleSentences.english: Everyone says Grandpa's soup is delicious.

exampleSentences.pinyin: zhè gēn yùmǐ hěn tián.
exampleSentences.english: This cob of corn is very sweet.

exampleSentences.pinyin: yùmǐ kěyǐ zhǔ, yě kěyǐ kǎo.
exampleSentences.english: Corn can be boiled or grilled.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ zài hǎitān chī kǎo yùmǐ.
exampleSentences.english: I eat grilled corn at the beach.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 爸爸把玉米放進購物袋裡。
exampleSentences.pinyin: bàba bǎ yùmǐ fàng jìn gòuwùdài lǐ.
exampleSentences.english: Dad puts the corn into the shopping bag.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng chī bǎo le.
exampleSentences.english: I have already eaten enough.

exampleSentences.pinyin: gēge yǐjīng huí jiā le.
exampleSentences.english: My older brother has already gone home.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 我已經收好書包了，我們走吧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng shōu hǎo shūbāo le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
exampleSentences.english: I have already packed my school bag, so let's go.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 雨已經停了，我們去玩吧。
exampleSentences.pinyin: yǔ yǐjīng tíng le, wǒmen qù wán ba.
exampleSentences.english: The rain has already stopped, so let's go and play.

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒ hěn è.
exampleSentences.english: I am hungry.

exampleSentences.pinyin: nǐ è le ma?
exampleSentences.english: Are you hungry?

exampleSentences.hanzi: 足球練完，我餓得不得了。
exampleSentences.pinyin: zúqiú liàn wán, wǒ è de bùdéliǎo.
exampleSentences.english: After soccer training, I am starving.

exampleSentences.hanzi: 放學的時候，我好餓，肚子咕咕叫。
exampleSentences.pinyin: fàngxué de shíhou, wǒ hǎo è, dùzi gūgū jiào.
exampleSentences.english: When school finishes, I am so hungry my tummy is rumbling.

words.definition: to do more quickly, earlier, faster

exampleSentences.pinyin: kuàidiǎn, wǒmen yào chídào le.
exampleSentences.english: Hurry up, we are going to be late.

exampleSentences.pinyin: kuàidiǎn chī, fàn yào liáng le!
exampleSentences.english: Hurry up and eat, the food is going cold!

exampleSentences.hanzi: 快點把書包背好，我們要去學校了！
exampleSentences.pinyin: kuàidiǎn bǎ shūbāo bèi hǎo, wǒmen yào qù xuéxiào le!
exampleSentences.english: Quick, put your school bag on, we are going to school!

exampleSentences.pinyin: wǒmen kuàidiǎn qù hǎitān ba!
exampleSentences.english: Let's hurry to the beach!
